recommendation: Choose Option C with both C1 and C2 on the current record. First author the v9 remasurement against the current recorded joins and make its relationship to product-boundary-successor-contract.v8 explicit; then obtain the fresh application-grade dual review on v9, not on v8. After the owner-controlled DR-117 opening entry, author the G29/G30 fixture implementations and use a separate DR-117 SATISFIED-GRADE plus MF-6 cycle. Do not waive C1 merely because A4 might later adopt a content-based citation rule. A shared three-row Gate-2 ruling is lawful only if it includes a distinct DR-117 finding and preserves D-056's row-specific later review.
rationale: Both v8 verdicts expressly deny the application-grade/no-reservation limb, so C2 is necessary. C1 is also necessary on the current bytes: every one of v8's twelve cited joins has a recorded successor, v8's own remeasurement clause requires remeasurement when cited files move outside the stated carve-outs, and D-207 exists because the predecessor needed exactly such a remasurement. Claude's A4 waiver is unsupported. A4 is not adopted, its proposal addresses cross-lineage citations in recorded leftover-joins, and the B3 packet itself says whether that convention reaches preview-product-boundary-successor.v8 is not in the record. If v9 is created, an application-grade review of v8 cannot grade the different v9 bytes. The programme also must resolve which of the two artifacts named v8 is the Class A contract, because the preview v8 expressly says it does not replace the D-116 product-boundary contract. The Gate-2 portion is procedurally sound only as a scoped clarification: D-207 expressly keeps DR-117 Gates 2 and 3 true while preserving G29/G30 fixture-authoring leftovers, so those gate flags are not an automatic row-level contradiction, although authoring them before SATISFIED-GRADE is conservative under D-056.

A shared interpretive entry is lawful if it gives separate DR-131, DR-133, and DR-117 findings; D-056 separately requires the eventual SATISFIED-GRADE review of each individual row.

Order C1 before C2 and bind the application-grade verdict pair to v9's final digest.
